name: iter_scarcity_confirm
description: SCARCITY CONFIRMATION - 15-seed verification of the guided-wins-search discovery: at the cell (alpha 0.5, n_train 30, n_select 100, K=8) a severe candidate scarcity inside the gap (pool_deficit 0.98) turns the loop from recovery-to-parity into a COMPOUNDING guided win (round-1 gap -0.013 growing to -0.086 by round 8, 5/5 seeds, detection IoU holding at 0.12-0.2 instead of collapsing). Sweeps the deficit from the one-shot world (0.0) to near-total scarcity (0.995) across all four mix policies, to locate where the crossover happens and which policy is right on each side: when the deficit is transient the exponential dump is optimal (parity), when it is persistent the focus should be KEPT - and the severity-adaptive gate should ideally choose correctly on both sides by itself. 15 seeds.
